thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Detected repeated policy-engine panics in smart-routing (eu-west-1). Customer-facing 5xx spike for multiple tenants. Auto-fallback thrashing between variants observed. Paging oncall. thread_ts=1738201234

Maya (oncall): acked, joining. Can you dump the recent policy eval stack traces?

Carla (sre): I see a jump in 5xxs starting ~1738201100. Routing policy eval errors show 'panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference' in policy_evaluator.go:312. Repro on dev with same policy config.

Lee (policy-eng): pulling the live policy bundle now. Suspect the new region-match rule we pushed this morning.

Jordan (support): Impact: ACME and two other customers saw failed requests and degraded responses for ~12 minutes. Support tickets are getting noisy.

Maya (oncall): Immediate mitigation: can we disable smart-routing policy for eu-west-1 and force default routing to baseline variant? That should stop the thrash.

Lee (policy-eng): I can flip it. Applying emergency config: set routing.policy.enabled=false for eu-west-1 via admin console.

incident-bot: CHANGE event: routing.policy.enabled=false applied to region=eu-west-1 by Lee (policy-eng) at 1738201302 :white_check_mark:

Carla (sre): After disable: 5xx rate drops ~80% within 30s. Fallback thrash stops. Monitoring shows token throughput steady.

Olivia (pm): Good. Need status update for customers + root cause. Also, did the policy compile step miss something? We have CI grammar checks.

Lee (policy-eng): Found the offending rule. It used an unguarded expression accessing request.attributes.origin.country and then running a regex match. If origin is nil we hit a nil deref in the evaluator. The rule snippet:

```
rule {
  when request.attributes.origin.country =~ /(eu-.*)/
  then variant = "gptx-8b-int8"
}
```

On staging the attribute always existed, but prod has edge requests without origin set. We should've used a safe accessor or exists() guard.

Carla (sre): Also noticed the regex had an unescaped grouping that exacerbated the compiler path: `/(eu-.*)/` is fine but the way we pass the compiled RE into the policy VM can trigger a panic if the input is nil. We need defensive checks in the runtime.

Maya (oncall): Action items right now: 1) Leave policy disabled in eu-west-1. 2) Patch live policy to add guard: `request.attributes.origin != null && ...` 3) Roll a runtime patch to avoid panic on nil values. 4) Customer comms.

Lee (policy-eng): I'll submit a quick patch for the policy DSL and reapply after smoke test. Proposed fix snippet:

```
rule {
  when request.attributes.origin != null && request.attributes.origin.country =~ /^(eu-.*)$/
  then variant = "gptx-8b-int8"
}
```

I'll run policy-lint locally and run evaluator unit tests.

Carla (sre): I'll open a rollback/mitigation runbook entry and keep the region disabled until we've validated. Also creating an oncall alert to notify if 5xx > 1% for 5m.

Jordan (support): Drafting customer message: "We've mitigated an issue with routing rules in EU region causing intermittent errors. We're routing to a stable model variant while we deploy a fix. No data loss and requests will be retried automatically." Will share draft.

Lee (policy-eng): Pushed PR to fix guard + added unit test for nil attribute path. CI green locally but going through CI now. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/policy/PR/4821 :link:

incident-bot: CI status for PR 4821: pending -> success at 1738201560 :white_check_mark:

Lee (policy-eng): Rolling patched policy to a canary (10% traffic) in eu-west-1 for 5m while region-level policy still disabled.

incident-bot: CANARY deploy: policy-bundle v2026.3.4821 to eu-west-1 (10%) by Lee (policy-eng) at 1738201625

Carla (sre): Canary looks clean after 3m. No panics, 5xx ~ baseline. Scaling metrics normal.

Maya (oncall): After canary success, re-enable routing.policy.enabled=true but with the canary bundle pinned and fallback safety: always route to baseline if policy eval fails. Lee, can you add explicit try/catch in evaluator?

Lee (policy-eng): Yep adding runtime catch and metric for eval_errors. Also adding a policy compile-time static analyzer to catch potential nil access patterns. Will open follow-up tickets.

Olivia (pm): Please prepare a short incident summary and impact table for execs and ACME follow-up. Include timeline, root cause (unguarded nil access in policy rule), mitigation (region-level disable -> patched policy -> canary -> re-enable), and follow-ups (static analysis, runtime hardening, improved CI lint).

Carla (sre): Creating incident postmortem skeleton: https://docs.internal/incidents/1738201234. Assigning owners: Lee (fix), Carla (runtime hardening), Maya (alerts/runbooks), Olivia (customer comms).

Jordan (support): Customer message shared in #support-digest for review.

Maya (oncall): Marking issue as resolved for pager. Leaving monitoring in watch for 2 hours. If any regression, I'll reopen paging.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Status=mitigated at 1738201834. Pager cleared. :tada:

Lee (policy-eng): Postmortem notes: add policy-lint rule 'no direct attribute deref without null-check', runtime guard to return safe-fallback instead of throwing, and a test harness for random missing attributes.

Olivia (pm): Thanks everyone. Good catch-and-fix. Let's make sure support updates ACME with timeline and next steps. :thumbsup:

Carla (sre): Follow-ups created:
- RT-1001: Add runtime safe-eval to policy VM (owner: Carla)
- POL-4822: Static lint for nil-safe access (owner: Lee)
- OPS-3002: Add 5xx SLA alert for routing eval (owner: Maya)
- COMMS-2101: Customer outreach for impacted tenants (owner: Olivia)

Maya (oncall): Closing thread. Thanks team.
